name: – § 6 – Am 29
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: 6. Commends the work of the Policia Nacional, the Guardia Civil, the Spanish Armed Forces, the Spanish Red Cross, Caritas, non-governmental organisations, and other civil society organisations involved in the response to the crisis, often under exceptionally difficult circumstances; calls on the Spanish authorities to guarantee unhindered access to all reception and detention facilities in Ceuta for the UN High Commissioner for Refugees, the International Organization for Migration, the Spanish Ombudsman, the Frontex Fundamental Rights Officer, lawyers, accredited journalists and humanitarian organisations;
